**BLUF:** Ukrainian long-range strikes hit Russia's Kirishi refinery overnight, extending a campaign now visibly tightening domestic fuel supplies and prompting rationing in multiple regions ahead of Abu Dhabi talks. Russian forces struck a civilian aid site in Komyshuvakha (Zaporizhzhia), with 55 confirmed dead and searches ongoing. Limited X chatter on possible US action near Qeshm/Hormuz and ongoing tanker risks; Kraków shooting investigation finds no confirmed ideological motive. SonicWall SSL-VPN exploit (CVE-2026-19868) confirmed active with CISA KEV listing. PLA activity around Taiwan remained routine. Most other theatres quiet in window.[[1]](https://x.com/AUTOWAR25/status/2119900517912445417)

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @AUTOWAR25 and multiple accounts (09 Nov ~21:10 UTC) report Ukrainian drones struck Kirishi (Kinef) refinery in Leningrad Oblast; Leningrad governor confirmed fire (contained/extinguished), 113 drones downed regionally, one civilian killed by debris in Vsevolozhsk; satellite thermal data shows multiple hotspots at the site. Widely amplified as part of resumed refinery campaign; Russian MoD reported 430 drones downed nationwide.[[1]](https://x.com/AUTOWAR25/status/2119900517912445417)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @grok and Ukrainian accounts (09 Nov ~21:18 UTC) detail Russian FAB-3000 and other guided bombs striking school used as aid/shelter in Komyshuvakha (Zaporizhzhia) on 2 Nov; 55 bodies recovered, up to 19 missing, searches continue; Zelenskyy and regional officials cited. No independent geolocation or Russian confirmation in results.[[2]](https://x.com/grok/status/2119902537432051914)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @LuckyDvysb, @margopinbernard and analyst accounts (09 Nov ~21:23–21:17 UTC) circulate claims of US strike on Qeshm Island (IRGC member death officially traffic accident) alongside Hormuz tanker concerns and oil price movements on peace hopes; limited reach, mixed with broader Iran negotiation chatter.[[3]](https://x.com/LuckyDvysb/status/2119903664081108994)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @Bladesman77, @TVPWorld_com and Polish accounts (09 Nov ~21:25–21:23 UTC) note Kraków shooting suspect died in hospital; prosecutors state no evidence of specific political ideology (earlier far-right speculation walked back); national mourning and Independence March security heightened.[[4]](https://x.com/Bladesman77/status/2119904234627862634)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @LenardReads, @cybertzar and researchers (09 Nov ~20:14–18:37 UTC) confirm CISA added SonicWall SonicOS CVE-2026-19868 to KEV after confirmed exploitation allowing SAML/MFA bypass with valid alternate credentials; patching urged for Gen7/Gen8.[[5]](https://x.com/LenardReads/status/2119886241584013387)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @Chopsyturvey (09 Nov 12:59 UTC) reports routine PLA activity: 4 aircraft sorties (2 crossed median line), 6 PLAN vessels, 2 official ships around Taiwan in 24h period.[[6]](https://x.com/Chopsyturvey/status/2119776833986318639)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @PugTrader and accounts (09 Nov ~21:24 UTC) discuss Rep. Massie filing impeachment articles against SecDef Hegseth over war powers/Iran actions; political context and market implications noted.[[7]](https://x.com/PugTrader/status/2119904018151481442)

searched: Kirishi refinery; Komyshuvakha; Qeshm OR Hormuz tanker; Kraków shooting OR Krakow gunman; SonicWall CVE-2026-19868; PLA Taiwan median line; Hegseth impeachment; Ryazan refinery strike

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (09 Nov 20:24Z) reports Ukrainian forces struck elite Russian 'Rubicon' drone unit base in occupied Berdyansk.[[1]](https://x.com/AUTOWAR25/status/2119900517912445417)
[OSINT - WEB] Ukrainska Pravda (09 Nov 19:34Z) reports Russian attack damaged energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, leaving large parts of Dnipro and Kamianske without power.[[8]](https://x.com/canadapollution/status/2119900215276982682)
[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (09 Nov 18:34Z) reports Russian record daily losses for second time in a month per General Staff.[[2]](https://x.com/grok/status/2119902537432051914)
[OSINT - SOCIAL] Multiple accounts including @Black_Spark2 and @TheValueist (09 Nov) detail Kirishi refinery strike with satellite confirmation, governor statement, and resulting fuel rationing in several Russian regions (Karelia, Nizhny Novgorod, etc.); part of campaign hitting eight facilities since late October.[[9]](https://x.com/Black_Spark2/status/2119808549840695444)
[OSINT - SOCIAL] @grok and accounts (09 Nov) report ongoing Komyshuvakha strike details and power outages.[[2]](https://x.com/grok/status/2119902537432051914)

**Assessment:** Ukrainian deep-strike campaign is producing measurable Russian domestic fuel pressure (rationing returning after brief lift) while Russia sustains energy attacks on Ukraine; both sides entering Abu Dhabi talks with recent battlefield costs visible. Likely to feature in negotiations. Moderate confidence (multi-source corroboration on strikes and effects, limited unit-level damage confirmation).

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] Jerusalem Post (09 Nov 22:34Z) reports Trump says Saudi Arabia, Qatar want peaceful Iran resolution but US ready to strike if needed.[[1]](https://x.com/AUTOWAR25/status/2119900517912445417)
[OSINT - WEB] Middle East Eye (09 Nov 21:00Z) reports US-Qatar talks on Iran negotiations positive.[[10]](https://x.com/rintereconomia/status/2119890691476132134)
[OSINT - SOCIAL] Accounts (09 Nov) circulate limited claims of US action near Qeshm with Iranian attributions to accident; tanker/Hormuz risks ongoing.[[3]](https://x.com/LuckyDvysb/status/2119903664081108994)

**Assessment:** Diplomatic track active with Trump signaling strike option remains; no confirmed new US strikes in window. Roughly even chance of further escalation or de-escalation depending on Abu Dhabi outcomes. Moderate confidence (official statements and limited chatter).

### INDO-PACIFIC
[OSINT - SOCIAL] @Chopsyturvey (09 Nov) reports routine PLA activity with two aircraft crossing median line.[[6]](https://x.com/Chopsyturvey/status/2119776833986318639)

Quiet in window beyond routine (no surge or incidents).

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window.

### AFRICA
Quiet in window (GDELT Sudan/Egypt train collision non-strategic; no new verified escalations).

### AMERICAS
[OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets report Rep. Massie moves to impeach SecDef Hegseth.[[11]](https://x.com/medicmsh3141/status/2119898914254164350)

**Assessment:** Impeachment effort largely symbolic/political in lame-duck period; unlikely to pass but signals internal GOP friction. Low confidence on long-term impact.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
[SIGINT - VERIFIED] UK Admiralty NAVAREA and China MSA warnings (issued 5–7 Nov) declare live-fire, military training and space-debris zones in Hebrides, Yellow Sea, South China Sea, North Pacific (multiple IDs including NAVAREA XI 504/26 space debris 14–20 Nov, WZ 713/26 Hebrides live fire 12–14 Nov).[[1]](https://x.com/AUTOWAR25/status/2119900517912445417)

**Assessment:** Standard seasonal activity; one new space-debris warning overlaps potential launch windows but no anomalies reported. High confidence (official notices).

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain/Reuters (08–09 Nov) report ongoing Hormuz risks, freight rates rising, Iraqi export understandings.[[12]](https://x.com/boen2207/status/2119894797326639296)
[OSINT - SOCIAL] Refinery strike chatter adds secondary pressure on Russian exports amid domestic rationing.[[8]](https://x.com/canadapollution/status/2119900215276982682)

**Assessment:** Ukrainian strikes compounding Russian fuel/export constraints; Hormuz risks persist amid diplomacy. Likely to sustain upward pressure on global energy logistics short-term. Moderate confidence.

leads worked: 1 of 4 nav warnings carried (Sulu Sea space debris); 3 GDELT hotspots searched and carried (Kraków, Qeshm/Hormuz, Komyshuvakha); 1 passed over (Tigray partial).

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
[OSINT - SOCIAL] @Cyber_Intel_, @sans_isc and researchers (09 Nov) confirm active exploitation of SonicWall SonicOS SSL-VPN CVE-2026-19868 (single-factor/SAML MFA bypass); CISA KEV listed, patching urged with no word on specific victims.[[5]](https://x.com/LenardReads/status/2119886241584013387)

searched: SonicWall OR CISA KEV (via Section 1 query); CISA KEV headlines.

**Assessment:** Confirmed in-the-wild exploitation of boundary device flaw raises immediate patching priority for affected organizations; fits pattern of VPN targeting. High confidence (CISA listing + researcher posts).

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
No new verified incidents in window beyond routine.

searched: US HOMELAND headlines (no X query needed; nothing substantive).

**Assessment:** Quiet in window.

## FORECAST CHECK
1. TRIGGERED - Ukrainian refinery strikes continuing with visible fuel rationing in multiple Russian regions (Kirishi hit, Rosneft caps reported).
2. NOT TRIGGERED - No confirmed new US strikes on Qeshm/Hormuz targets in window.
3. NOT TRIGGERED - No major PLA surge (>50 sorties) across median line; only routine activity reported.
4. OPEN - SonicWall exploit confirmed active but no specific infrastructure breach or CISA incident report yet.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- Sustained Ukrainian refinery strikes disabling additional capacity or extending rationing to Moscow/St. Petersburg core → measurable Russian export shortfall and Abu Dhabi leverage shift → visible in Russian MoD/Energy Ministry statements or port data within 7 days → likely.
- Confirmed Iranian retaliation (shipping incident or proxy action) following any US/Qeshm activity → UKMTO advisories or freight spike → within 24–48h → unlikely.
- >20 PLA aircraft crossing Taiwan median line in 24h period → INDOPACOM or allied response signals → within 48h → unlikely.
- CISA or major vendor confirms infrastructure breach from SonicWall CVE → broader patching mandates or incident reports → within 72h → roughly even chance.

## COLLECTION GAPS
- Independent confirmation of unit-level damage or production impact at Kirishi beyond fire and governor statement.
- Verification of any US action near Qeshm beyond Iranian social claims and accident attribution.
- Motive and ideological assessment in Kraków case as investigation continues.
- Specific victims or scale of SonicWall exploitation beyond KEV listing.
